capabilities: Embed a live or static folder tree in a note with filter, depth, and extension options
Add per-row comments to embedded folder trees
Draft folder structures as blueprint notes before anything exists on disk
Import a real folder as a snapshot or live view into a blueprint
Include one blueprint inside another note
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin store; the README gives manual install steps (build or download a GitHub release).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize a folder structure inside a note or to plan a folder layout before creating it on disk.
summary: Folder-tree designer that embeds live or static folder trees in notes and lets you draft folder structures as editable blueprints.
